findings.finding: The citation section still says discriminator or atomic and only prefers atomic. This leaves two implementation contracts even though the proposed interface and review goal require one bounded path.
findings.required_closure: Delete the alternative. Freeze IssueConceptCitationQuery830G3 as the only G3-aware production handler path. It must receive raw release_id occurrences and preparation_id key presence, classify the selected exact immutable release, reject malformed G3 query shape before Evidence resolution/token signing, then issue for that same exact release. Older test doubles may retain the legacy fallback; the production SchemaWikiService must implement the atomic interface.

necessary_contract_precision.requirement: State exact extraction and selection: values := c.Request.URL.Query(); releaseOccurrences, releasePresent := values["release_id"]; preparationPresent := key presence in values; selected := strings.TrimSpace(first occurrence) when present. Nil means absent. Empty or whitespace-only first occurrence selects current for page and remains unavailable for citation, exactly matching current handler behavior. Do not use c.Query/GetQuery for cardinality.
Keep v2 wording: unrelated query keys remain ignored. Scope is path/request identity, not query. No unknown-key rejection test belongs in this repair.

confirmed_closures.result: ReadConceptPageQuery830G3 classifies and projects from one WikiReleasePinnedRead, so G2-to-G3 Head movement cannot turn an already-classified request into a different release read.

The proposed atomic issuer can reject G3 repeated/empty/mixed shape before Evidence resolution and token signing. Citation already selects a nonempty exact immutable release, so no current-Head lookup is needed.
Classification is based on the same legacy-selected target. A selected G2 release receives no new cardinality/mixed/unknown-key rule and retains first-value/empty behavior.
Existing requestIdentity obtains wiki/space/raw from route parameters; there are no required scope query keys to preserve.
One additional handler production path plus private reuse in the already-open G3 service; no route, public DTO, repository, table, wire contract, or second Head.

required_tests: G3 current page absent release accepted and mutable Head advances after sole pin without changing returned release.
G3 current/exact repeated, explicit-empty or whitespace-empty, and preparation_id key presence reject before projection or token issuance.
G2 selected by first value retains repeated/empty/mixed and unrelated-key behavior; include first-G2/second-G3 and first-empty/current-G2 cases.
Citation single nonempty exact G3 succeeds; repeated or preparation-present has issuer/token call count zero.

rejected.reason: Current page classification and read observed Head twice and could bypass the G3 query gate after G2-to-G3 Head movement.
